segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Welcome both of you! This session gets your laptops and accounts set up so you're ready by lunch.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Thanks, Neha.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: Excited to get started.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: First, open the laptop and log in with the temporary credentials from the welcome email.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Done. It's asking me to change the password.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Yes, pick something long, a passphrase is best. Then install the device management profile when prompted.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: Mine is downloading the profile now.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Next is single sign-on. Open the identity portal and enroll your authenticator app.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: My phone isn't scanning the QR code.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: No problem, I'll push a manual enrollment. The one-time code is 482 913, enter that within five minutes. And for your recovery codes, write these down: 7731-KQPA, 2209-ZMRT, 5518-HWLE.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Got it, I'm in.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: Mine worked with the QR code.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Great. Next, request access to the tools you need through the access portal. Your manager approves each request.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: Do we request the code repository access there too?

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Yes, everything goes through the portal so we have an audit trail.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: What about the VPN?

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: You won't need it. Everything is behind single sign-on now.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: Nice. And if something breaks?

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Post in the help channel or email the IT help address. We answer within an hour during the day.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Thank you, this was really smooth.
